      "section": "mod-tome/data/general/npcs/lich.lua",
      "source": "An elder being from a now-forgotten age, filled and fueled by its hate and rage toward all things living, it seeks to deprive all others of a prize it cannot have... life.",

      "section": "mod-tome/data/general/npcs/losgoroth.lua",
